description: Coin duel concept B v3, layout B2: smaller coins, both duel cards inside the board frame on its inner left side. Coin assets, sound, timing and dim are exactly v3/B.

dim.fade_out: starts at outro_start = last_settle + result_hold_s, lasts outro_fade_s, linear to 0
dim.note: draw the dim above the board and below the two duel cards and the coins

layout.unit: card_h = on-screen height of each duel card; H_in / W_in = board inner rect height / width

cards.top_card: x = inner.x0 + margin, y = inner.y0 + margin
cards.bottom_card: x = inner.x0 + margin, y = inner.y1 - margin - card_h

as_fraction_of_inner_rect.format: [x, y, w, h] relative to inner rect origin/size

coins.first_coin_offset_note: first coin centre x = card right edge + 0.24*card_h (0.09*card_h gap + radius 0.15); next coins +pitch to the right
coins.row_y: coin centre y = card centre y
coins.sprite_scale: scale = (0.30*card_h)/160; place each canvas so its timing.json anchor (scaled) sits on the coin centre
coins.draw_order: coins still in the air (t < impact) above settled/bouncing coins

fit_rule.rule: card.x + card_h*(2/3 + 0.24 + (n-1)*0.36 + 0.33) <= safe_right  for n = 5  (0.33 = half the scaled 352 px sprite canvas = max in-flight coin + shadow)
fit_rule.vertical: card centre y -/+ 0.33*card_h stays inside the inner rect (always true with these card boxes)
fit_rule.if_it_fails: shrink card_h (or pitch down to 0.33*card_h) until the rule holds

layout.preview_example_1080p: see at_1080p values above (previews use exactly these)

timing.stagger_note: coin i (0-based, left to right) of EACH row starts at first_start_s + i*stagger_s (+0..jitter); both rows start together
timing.late_coin_rule: exactly one coin uses the 'late' variant: in the row with more coins (bottom on a tie); index n-1 if n<3, n-1 if n==3, n//2+1 if n>3

variant_rule: non-late coins: variant_cycle[(i + (row=='top')) % 3] (any choice works; heads/tails of the same variant have identical timing)

sound.per_coin_gain_note: gain for every one-shot of a coin = -6*log10(total coins) dB + random ±gain_jitter_db
sound.pitch_note: playbackRate = 2^(st/12), one random st per coin
sound.rattle_rule: the late coin always rattles; with >2 coins only 2 random others also rattle
sound.bus_note: reference previews are mastered to -17.85 LUFS (pyloudnorm; ffmpeg ebur128 reads -17.5..-18) / <= -3 dBTP; in game, a light limiter on the coin bus is recommended (the raw sum peaks are listed in the preview *_layout.json)

board_frame.note: inner edge of the battlefield board frame (parchment area), measured on the 1920x1080 battlefield screenshot
board_frame.corner_ornaments: gold corner pieces curve ~70 px into the parchment at each corner (rounded parchment corners, radius ~70 px); the 0.045*H_in margin keeps card corners clear
board_frame.ui_inside_or_touching: mana badges top-right (x1416-1560, y12-75) and bottom-right (x1416-1565, y935-1000); end-turn button right edge (x>=1560, y490-560); hand cards top/bottom centre (y<130 and y>860)
